An Agentic Operating System Learns to Compile
item.description: Veda, a boutique agent-native OS experiment, has added support for GCC and OpenGL, attempting to bridge autonomous control loops with traditional systems programming tools. The obvious risk is building a convoluted layer of abstraction where deterministic machine instructions are mediated by non-deterministic heuristics.

The Death of Effort Signals in the Age of GenAI
item.description: Generative AI has weaponized personalization, turning traditional trust markers—like tailored recruiter outreach and professional design—into hollow tactics. This has forced recipients to spend extra energy unmasking automation, destroying the very signaling value those touches once held. Quote: It used to be easy to spot effort: a cool logo on a business card, an interesting website design, a recruiter email that speaks to a specific experience I have on my LinkedIn profile.
